title: What your team gets
subtitle: NQ research for your existing trading process
intro: For professional trading and research teams that want qualifying NQ targets during the session, a record of what followed, and weekly statistics to evaluate the research over time.

offer.title: Real-time targets during the trading session
offer.body: Sign in to Today's Targets to see target prices, direction, source timestamps, and current status. The dashboard checks for updates every 60 seconds. Source timestamps are not delivery times. Instant delivery is not guaranteed; some sessions produce no qualifying targets.

offer.title: Completed-session reports
offer.body: Review the target log, reached and unreached outcomes, timing, and session context in the dashboard and completed-session email reports. Use the records alongside your own evaluation process, not as instructions to enter or exit trades.

offer.title: Weekly target statistics
offer.body: Compare target counts, outcomes, and resolution timing across the week. Inspect sample sizes, partial periods, and missing information. Weekly statistics help you evaluate more than one session; they do not establish future reliability.

delivery: Every license includes the authenticated dashboard and email reports. Desk Intelligence and Firm-Wide Enterprise add a read-only daily, weekly, and history API and approved webhooks. The paid API does not expose live targets. Confirm webhook scope during onboarding; do not assume live target alerts by email or webhook.
sampleText: Preview selected reached and unreached records on the website. Request the full October 12, 2026 report to inspect all nine targets. Delivery follows work-email confirmation and review. One historical session illustrates the deliverable, not typical results. Times are confirming candle closes, not delivery or execution times.
boundary: Target outcomes are not customer trading returns. Harper Vance does not place orders, monitor your firm's trades, or provide personalized investment advice. Your team retains every trading decision.
purchaseTitle: Choose the access your team needs
purchaseIntro: The core research is the same. License differences cover users, history, integrations, and internal-use rights. Prices and scope are confirmed in the applicable agreement and order before payment.

steps.title: 1. Request access
steps.body: Choose a license, submit the business application, and confirm your work email. Requests are reviewed for qualification and available capacity. Applying does not collect payment or activate access.

steps.title: 2. Review the agreement and billing terms
steps.body: Approved customers review the applicable agreement and order, including billing interval, taxes, renewal, cancellation, and usage restrictions. Standard licenses use approved hosted checkout. Enterprise uses an agreed contract-managed billing process.

steps.title: 3. Complete payment and onboarding
steps.body: Access follows verified payment and the required organization and user setup. A request, payment-page redirect, or sample download alone does not activate the service. Confirm your access arrangements before relying on the service.

terms: This overview is not the subscription agreement. Redistribution, retention, expanded seats, and service commitments are governed by the applicable license and Order Form. No guaranteed trading outcome or delivery-latency commitment is offered here.
